text: Frozen benchmarks/motion/protocol-v1.json v1.0.0 (SHA-256 660a1bfcc01199a911031bcd080875862d56727f541aa74adb6f75e6d01ea087), documented it in docs/motion-superiority-protocol.md, and linked the evidence plan. The protocol preregisters 24 analytic subjects, four complete-affine scenarios, a separate >=12-subject real-anatomy veto stratum, two mandatory courts, four co-primary endpoints, positive superiority and scenario non-inferiority margins, paired subject-cluster inference, multiplicity, absolute/fidelity/failure gates, timing randomization, exact claim language, and receipt retention. The dependency-free validator and mutation tests pass. Claim admission correctly fails without a SHA-bound external lock containing clean candidate artifacts, comparator digests/versions, complete public-data provenance/licenses/checksums, and hardware controls.
